proficiencies.name: Admixtures
proficiencies.description: A practiced hand with admixtures, you expertly concoct and carry potent brews and salves, enhancing their effects and never lacking vital remedies when they’re needed most.

ranks.effect: Your maximum Compact size for this equipment type increases to 6.
Your maximum Compact size for this equipment type increases to 7.
Your maximum Compact size for this equipment type increases to 8.

proficiencies.special: Your restoration potency for Health, Focus, and Reflex Admixtures increases to 150% (round up).

proficiencies.name: Grenades
proficiencies.description: Your skill with grenades lets you launch explosives farther and with greater control, raining havoc on the enemy from a safe distance.

ranks.effect: Your throwing range for all explosives increases by 5m.
Your throwing range for all explosives increases by 10m.
Your throwing range for all explosives increases by 15m.

proficiencies.special: All of your Explosives’ Durability increases by 2 and their area of effect by 1 sqm.

proficiencies.name: Snares
proficiencies.description: As a trap specialist, you lay snares with masterful subtlety, making them harder to spot and ensuring unwary foes stumble right into your carefully laid plans.

ranks.effect: The Risk Threshold to detect or disarm your snares increases by 1.
The Risk Threshold to detect or disarm your snares increases by 2.
The Risk Threshold to detect or disarm your snares increases by 3.

proficiencies.special: The Stamina requirement and the Risk Threshold to set your snares is reduced by 1.
